name: oss-naming-cleanup-lab-codex-omx
title: OSS naming cleanup: lab description + .Codex rename + omx removal
description: Pre-open-source naming cleanup, three coordinated items: (1) Fix the lab package description that still says 'koala 离线优化实验室' — change to lattice equivalent. (2) Rename the .Codex/ directory (project's own codex adapter assets, NOT the lowercase .codex/ which is Codex CLI's hard-required native hook dir) to .lattice-codex/ across all 32 referencing files; this resolves the case-insensitive filesystem collision risk on macOS. (3) Remove the OMX disable guard entirely — the user never wanted .omx polluting their workspace; delete the .gitignore entry, the verify-omx-disabled.mjs script, the AGENTS.md prohibition, and the source-code refusal logic that pretends omx is supported-but-disabled. Both items 2 and 3 touch decision documents, so this story will trip the always-on 3x2 decision-doc quorum gate (clearing it via the user-approved degraded 3x1 fallback per memory).

riskSignalsDismissed.reason: False positive: the keyword token only appears as part of a cited audit-doc filename docs/audits/lattice-token-cost-and-takeover-audit.md in the .Codex reference list, not because this story modifies any security/credential/token logic. This is a pure naming cleanup (lab description rebrand + directory rename + omx guard removal); no security or credential code is changed.
